raw_content:
rules:
- id: "vuln-aiohttp-1c335944"
  pattern: |
    filepath = directory.joinpath(filename).resolve()
    if not follow_symlinks:
  pattern-not: |
    filepath = directory.joinpath(filename).resolve()
    if follow_symlinks:
  languages: ["python"]
  message: "Potential directory traversal vulnerability detected in aiohttp's static file serving. If 'follow_symlinks' is set to False, a malicious user can craft a path that resolves to a file outside the intended directory."
  severity: ERROR
  metadata:
    category: security
    cwe: CWE-297
    owasp: A1:2021-XML External Entities (XXE)
    references:
      - https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Directory_Traversal_Cheat_Sheet.html
      - https://docs.aiohttp.org/en/stable/web_middlewares.html#aiohttp.static.StaticMiddleware
      - https://docs.aiohttp.org/en/stable/web_middlewares.html#aiohttp.web.FileResponse
    technology: ["python", "aiohttp"]
